translation.name: Pab tummad karta pab Jesucristobal igal-pin mezhijad

content: Anmal Moisés-igalgin-kalesgudiid-akar ololgusmal Pab Purpa Nuedbal Pabga arpagal
Kwenamalad, imi pemal-Moisés-igal-wismalad nued wismaldo, tule ampa tuladiil, Moisés-igal-mamikid-ulpallí naneed-wilubmal. Tenal tule purkwenonikil, Moisés-igal-mamikid-ulpallí-naneed pelgunoniko.

Imi anmalga Moisés-igal maido: imi ome-e-machered tula-tiil, ome aga e-macheredbak mecha naneed-wilubmal. Tenal ome igal-kwen-nikchul machered-pid nikugal. Tenal ome-e-machered-tarbi-purkwijal, kep ome igal nikanoniko machered-pid-nikugal.

Imi ome e-machered ampa tuladgin machered-pid-nikujal, we ome pato iskus. Tenal ome-e-machered tarbi-purkwijal, ome-e-macheredbak-mecha-kudiid pelgunoniko. Imi ome e-machered-purkwijad-cholbal machered-pid-nikunonikil, kwen iskuojul.

Kwenamalad, imi pemalga ampa teopí kunonimalmo. Imi pemalga Cristo sanal purkwijadbal Moisés-igal-mamikid pemalga pato pelgunonimalmo, tule purkwijadyob. Imi ome machered-pid-nikujadyob pemal Cristogadga kunonimalmo. Tenal Pab Tummad purkwaled-akar Cristo-otulos, anmal Pab Tummadga yer arpagal.

Tenal anmal ampa kusgu iskuedgin kudigu, iskued ampa anmalgin wilub-okpin. Imi teun Moisés-igal-mamikidbal anmal iskuedgin nanebi-kualda. Tenal we iskued anmal-chan izhononida, purkwedzhe-anmal-chedgal.

Tenal tule-purkwijadyob ilgwen iskued-igesmaladbal, anmal Moisés-igalgin-kalesgudiid-akar ololgusmal. Al anmal Pab-Purpa-Nued-igal-pinbal Pab Tummadga arpago, tenal Moisés-akpenegwad-igal-nermalejadbal chul.
Pablo chogzhagujad iskued anmal-ulubgin togbi-kunai

¿Tede anmal igi Moisés-igalgin chogojun? ¿Imi Moisés-igal ib-nuedzhul? Chulá. Imi Moisés-igal ib-nuedga megnoni. Tenal Moisés-igal megnonijulilen, an kwen wichulin ibi iskued. Imi Moisés-igalbal anmalga igal mai melle twagdar immal-peigugal. Tenal Moisés-igal megwiszhulilen, an kwen wichulbalin twagdar-immal-peigueddin, iskued.
Tenal Moisés-igal-mamikidbal iskued-ankin-maid igal-nikunoni peyedzhe-akal-akal-immal-peigugal an-imakalda. Tenal Moisés-igal maichulilen, we iskued kal kwen nikchulin, iskuedgin an-egwangal.
Tenal akpene-akar Moisés-igal maichulilen, an purkwed kwen nikchulin. Tenal Moisés-igal megnoni-choggu, al anmalga iskued nononijun. Tegin an iskuedgin purpal purkwenonijun.
Imi Moisés-igal-mezhijad an-otuloged-wiluban, tenal Moisés-igal pul-kigma an-opurkwenoni.
Imi Moisés-igal-mamikidbal iskued-ankin-maid igal-nikunoni an-yardagal, tegin purpal an-mesgalbal.
Tenal Moisés-igal-mamikid igal-iskanajul, igal-chwilidikid. Tenal Pab-Moisésga-igal-chogzhad igal-chwilidikid, igal-napírragwad tegin igal-nuedbal.

¿Tenal Moisés-igal-nued-chogedde, tede an-mejodé? Chulá. ¿Tede igijun? Nabir. Imi Moisés-igal-mamikid, igal-nued. Tenal Moisés-igal-nuedbal iskued-noni an-opurkwegal. Tenal Moisés-igal oyonaido iskued-igal, iskued-chunchunnad. Tenal anmal Moisés-igal-mamikidbal wisgunonimalbal we iskued pul igal-iskanaga kunoni.
Tenal anmal wismaldo, Moisés-igal, igal-nued, Pab-akar-tanikid. Tenal antin iti-napkined-choggu, al an iskuedgin-kalesgudiid-tule.
Tenal an immal-nuegan-imabied an kwen imajul. Tenal an yapa immal-iskana-imaked an keg-chulgu imakalda. Al an mag kwen itojul, ibiga an weob immal ima.
Tenal an-yapa-immal-iskana-imakedbal tenal an yabli immal-iskana imanonikil, webal mag taklenoni antin tule-iskanajul, tenal an chogmodo: “Moisés-igalde, igal-nued.”
Al antin iskued kwen imajul, tenal iskued-ankin-maid immal-akalogal an-ima.
Tenal an nued wisdo, an-changin-iskued-maidbal an keg immal-nuegan-ima. Al an immal-nuegan imabi-kualil, keg an immal-nuegan ima.
Imi an-immal-imanail, an immal-nuegan-imabiedyob immal kwen imajul. Tenal an-yapa-iskued-imaked keg-chulgu an immal imakalda.
Nabir. Imi an-yapa-immal-imaked an imakel, wedin chogle an naga tukin weob kwen nanejul. Tenal iskued-ankin-maid istar-nanegal an-imakalda.
Imi an naga mag itononido, an immal-nuegan imabiel, iskued kusgu ankin maimo, immal akalogal.
Tenal antin, an naga ulubgin yer Pab-igal itononida.
Tenal an naga mag itobaldo an-changa igal-pid maimo. Al we igal an-pinzheedbak kal-itogaldamal. Tegin an naga mag itobaldo, an-chan-ilbal-iskued-mamikidbal, an iskued-igalgin kalesgudii.
¡Imi antin tule-wiles! ¿Toa an-changin iskued maid-akar an-abonogo, we iskued melle an-opurkwegal?

Tenal antin Pab Tummadga tog-nuedi chogdo, Pab Tummad nabir anmal-Tummad-Jesucristobal anmal-abonogo, iskued melle an chanbal nanegal. Imi antin naga ulubgin Pab-chogzhad-pallí, Pabga arpa. Tenal an-chandin iskuedgin kalesgudimo.
